description: This file defines a report parser class for generating VAT declaration reports in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including methods for retrieving and processing accounting data, tax codes, and report formatting.

classes.name: tax_report
classes.description: A report parser class for VAT declaration, extending rml_parse.rml_parse, with methods to gather and process accounting and tax data for report generation.

methods.name: _get_lines
methods.description: Generates a list of account lines with tax data, including hierarchical codes and general account info.

methods.name: _get_period
methods.description: Retrieves the name of an account period given its ID.

methods.name: _get_general
methods.description: Calculates aggregated tax amounts, debits, credits for a specific tax code over a list of periods and a company.

methods.name: _get_codes
methods.description: Recursively retrieves tax codes based on parent-child relationships and 'based_on' criteria.

methods.name: _add_codes
methods.description: Associates account list entries with summed tax code periods.

methods.name: _get_company
methods.description: Fetches the company name based on form data.

methods.name: _get_currency
methods.description: Fetches the company's currency name based on form data.

methods.name: sort_result
methods.description: Sorts and groups account lines, inserting subtotal lines based on account levels.
